[engine] With one outlier in N runs, the honest output is the REPEATABLE BAND, not the range and not the target. The range only says an outlier exists; the target only says it was reached once. Quote the cluster, and count how many runs cleared it.

## 為什麼（because）

250 t/s was reached (286.67, and 254.74 / 264.78 / 276.59 on 09-14/15) and so was 122.68 -- 1/11 runs cleared 250 across two batches of identical commands. The informative reading is that ten of eleven runs sit in 155.33-184.09 (18.5%), i.e. the engine's operating point is a stable ~170 t/s band and 250 is the outlier, not the other way round. Reporting 'range 155-287' would have suggested a wide but centred distribution; reporting '1/11 cleared 250, band 155-184' names the operating point and prices the gap at 1.36x.
